metadata.schedule_summary: ONCE WEEKLY. First 3 administrations 60 mg/m², total maximum 120 mg. From administration 4,80 mg/m² (maximum 160 mg) only after the team reviews nadirs and toxicity.60 or 50 mg/m²/lower may be needed. Continue weekly while helpful and tolerated; no fixed total number of weeks.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.

clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the current NCCP source. It does not replace the NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review or pharmacy verification.
clinical_governance.route_safety_note: IV and oral vinorelbine use different schedules, dose levels, blood-count and hepatic rules. They are not mg-for-mg interchangeable. IV administration is never intrathecal.

supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for oral SACT
supportive_care.mapping_basis: Current NCCP route-specific antiemetic guidance; weekly oral vinorelbine requires an explicit prophylaxis duration.
supportive_care.antiemetic_note: Use the oral moderate-high pathway: one 5-HT3 antagonist, e.g. ondansetron 8–16 mg totaldaily OR granisetron 1–2 mg totaldaily. Table 5 says continue daily on subsequent days; specify duration for this once-weekly schedule in the individual prescription. This is not the IV moderate dexamethasone/NK 1 regimen.
supportive_care.bowel_plan: Constipation prevention; prescribe laxatives according to symptoms/risk, especially with opioids. Ondansetron may worsen constipation. Suspected ileus is urgent.
supportive_care.monitoring_note: FBC before every weekly treatment (HPRA: on the day of each administration); renal/liver tests at cycle start and neuropathy surveillance. Record nadirs for first 3, on 80 and after reduction before escalation decisions.
supportive_care.administration_note: Once weekly with food; swallow whole with water. Do not take a second dose after vomiting; return damaged capsules. Pharmacy confirms capsule strengths, number and dose caps.

treatment_phases.label: First three weekly administrations
treatment_phases.duration_text: Three administrations, each once weekly; delays move the actual dates.

administration.notes: Use NCCP capsule table; with food, swallow whole. Never daily.

treatment_phases.label: Subsequent weekly administrations — dose confirmed after nadir review
treatment_phases.duration_text: Continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity; dose 80 only if escalation criteria satisfied. Continued 60 or lower may be required.

administration.notes: 80 mg/m² is conditional, not a scheduled automatic increase. Lower 60 or 50 plans may apply. Never convertmg-for-mg from IV.
